content.purpose: Build Python AI features with Genkit, including generation, streaming, tool use, flows, and multi-turn agents.
content.whenToUse: Use this guidance to choose agent or flow patterns, configure a Python Genkit app, and run or inspect it with the Genkit CLI.
content.outputs: It provides Python code patterns and practical setup, execution, and trace-debugging steps for Genkit apps.
